description: ⭐ PREFERRED: Search and filter todos efficiently. Use instead of list_todos to conserve tokens. Omit calendar_url to search across ALL calendars automatically.

calendar_url.description: Optional: Specific calendar URL. Omit to search ALL calendars (recommended).

limit.description: Maximum number of todos to return (default 20, max 500). You get the earliest by due date, and the response states how many matched in total.

status_filter.description: Filter by todo status. Use "NEEDS-ACTION" for pending tasks, "COMPLETED" for done tasks. Can be used alone as sufficient filter.

summary_filter.description: Search todo summaries/titles containing this text (case-insensitive). Example: "write report" or "review PR". Can be used alone as sufficient filter.

time_range_end.description: End datetime for due date filtering (ISO 8601). If provided, time_range_start is REQUIRED. Both dates together form a complete filter.

time_range_start.description: Start datetime for due date filtering (ISO 8601). If provided, time_range_end is REQUIRED. Both dates together form a complete filter.

name: todo_query
